source: The PaLM paper reports that this enabled fusion of the attention and MLP input matrix multiplications and produced roughly 15% faster training at large scale in their setup, while their ablations showed scale-dependent quality effects. [10]
zh: PaLM 论文报告称，这使得注意力和 MLP 输入矩阵乘法得以融合，并在其设置中将大规模训练速度提高了约 15%，同时其消融显示出与规模相关的质量效应。 [10]
